Team Chiron

I am an M.S. Research student in Mechanical Engineering at Carnegie Mellon University. As part of Team Chiron, I work on the DARPA Triage Challenge, focusing on SWaP-constrained UAV exploration for casualty identification and vision-language reasoning for triage assessment in disaster-response scenarios.

Previously, I was a Design Engineer at Caterpillar, where I contributed to improving the quality of large-scale mining vehicles.

Research Focus

  • SWaP-constrained autonomy: Efficient UAV exploration designed for constrained disaster-response environments.
  • Vision-language reasoning for triage: Multimodal reasoning for assessing casualty conditions and supporting triage decisions.
